description: Covers keeping research software alive and responsible over time: ongoing maintenance practice, tracking and paying down technical debt, reducing the bus factor, and deprecating or archiving honestly. Use when the user asks how to maintain or sustain a project, stop it rotting, schedule CI to catch breakage from external change, track or pay down tech debt, plan maintenance funding or shared ownership, or retire or deprecate software. (Energy and carbon footprint of computing is rseng-green-computing; dependency updating and auditing detail is rseng-dependency-management; archiving mechanics are rseng-archiving.)
